chrome_hint: Search Leski Auctions realised prices, Davidson Auctions, Lawsons, Theodore Bruce, Mossgreen and Bonhams Australia (last 10 years) for 'Victorian cedar bookcase two height glazed arched doors', 'colonial cedar cottage bookcase', 'cedar chiffonier bookcase'. LiveAuctioneers and Invaluable sold filter 'Australian cedar bookcase'. eBay sold (Australia): 'antique cedar bookcase Victorian' (pickup only, so mostly Tasmanian/Vic dealers). Check dealer asking at Antiques Online / Trove-style sites 'cedar cottage bookcase'.
viewing_check: Confirm timber: look at the back boards, drawer linings and inside of doors for red cedar (open grain, red-brown, scent) versus mahogany veneer on pine. Check whether top and base are a true marriage (matching timber, wear, size). Look for drawer dovetails, original glass, restoration or split top, finish patches, woodworm. Measure H, W, D. Photograph drawer sides and back.
